content.text: Randomized differential testing (including unsorted rows, quantifiers, aggregates, duplicate-source strata, and multi-literal clauses) has matched the naive reference in 350 cases. Next I’m stress-testing the largest bounded context/AST workloads and then I’ll run a focused validation/error-precedence suite.

cat > /workspace/devtests/stress_eval.py <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,time,random,os
rng=random.Random(4);K=8
schema=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':'SIZE','min':-2147483648,'max':2147483647} for i in range(16)]

def leaf(a):
    if a%3==0:return {'field':f'f{a%16}','at':'$'}
    if a%3==1:return {'aggregate':'mean','field':f'f{a%16}','from':a%4,'to':7-(a%3)}
    return {'scale':(a%7)-3,'term':{'field':f'f{a%16}','at':a%8}}
def tree(base):
    vs=[leaf(base+i) for i in range(8)]
    while len(vs)>1:vs=[{'add':[vs[i],vs[i+1]]} for i in range(0,len(vs),2)]
    return vs[0]
atoms=[]
for i in range(20):
    atoms.append({'quantifier':'any' if i%2 else 'all','from':0,'to':7,'predicate':{'cmp':['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge'][i%6],'left':tree(i*2),'right':tree(i*2+11)}})
def traces(part,contexts,count):
    # Spread contexts over traces, keeping each row count >= K.
    out=[];remaining=contexts
    for z in range(count):
        n=remaining//(count-z)
        remaining-=n
        rows=[{'t':j*3,'values':[rng.randint(-1000,1000) for _ in range(16)]} for j in range(n+K-1)]
        rng.shuffle(rows)
        out.append({'id':part+str(z),'source':'s'+str(z%16),'rows':rows})
    return out
req={'version':1,'schema':schema,'window':K,'atoms':atoms,'policy':{'max_width':4,'min_support':1,'min_witness':1},'train':traces('tr',4096,16),'probes':traces('pr',128,1),'queries':traces('qu',1024,4)}
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode();print('input',len(data),'ast nodes each',sum(1 for _ in []))
t=time.time();p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=170)
print('return',p.returncode,'wall',time.time()-t,'out bytes',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:1000]);print(p.stdout[:300])
open('/workspace/devtests/stress_eval.out','wb').write(p.stdout)
